semantics.base_rule: Runtime boot begins from Absolute Base Zero.
semantics.additive_rule: Declared USE/user selections add only explicitly selected capabilities/modules and required explicitly declared structure.
semantics.exclusive_rule: Where `use` or `user` selection semantics apply, only listed capabilities are enabled according to profile rules.
semantics.dependency_rule: Dependencies are validated but never silently auto-enabled.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing required dependency hard-fails unless explicitly pruned/disabled by compatible policy.
semantics.negative_rule: Negative pruning is explicit and cannot silently remove required dependencies.
semantics.remediation_rule: User-facing failure should provide one clear remediation line where applicable.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Boot profile applies to an exact runtime/accepted snapshot context.

invariants.rule: Repository acceptance establishes canonical source state; runtime activation/reload is a separate explicit lifecycle operation over an exact accepted snapshot.
